preparation: Patch-clamped isolated Saccharomyces cerevisiae vacuoles. Voltage is cytosol minus lumen.
assay: Current in the presence of ATP, ADP and phosphate minus the ATP-free baseline. Reversal is the zero of that difference current.
limits: Five reversals were resolved and three were reported only as bounds. E_ATP describes the authors' estimated hydrolysis free energy divided by F, including pH-dependent fuel speciation. E_H is their calculated proton equilibrium voltage. Neither column is an independently measured pump current or ATP turnover.
